images.name: cover
images.title: How to train an *AI Employee* on your business
images.sub: Write down how the job is done here, clean up the documents, and turn every correction into a rule.

images.name: steps
images.title: Training an AI Employee, *in order*
steps: Watch the person who does it best
An afternoon of listening for the exceptions and small judgment calls.
Organised by situation, in full sentences, with the tone spelled out.
Current prices and policies only. Old versions deleted, conflicts fixed.
20 or 30 past emails or notes you'd send again, including hard ones.
Each escalation says what to tell the customer and who gets it.
Test it on last month's work
30 to 50 real cases, compared with what your staff actually did.
Turn every correction into a rule
Supervised first weeks, then a short weekly log review.

images.name: new-hire-vs-ai
images.title: What a new hire picks up, *what an AI Employee needs written*
head: New hire
AI Employee
rows: Shadows a coworker for a week or two
A written handbook, organised by situation
Overhears them at the front desk
Only knows the ones someone wrote down
Treats every document it's given as true
The handbook stays with the business
images.source: Training an AI Employee leaves the AI model untouched

images.name: handbook
images.title: A handbook page for *law firm intake*
rows: Replies within the hour and asks for the matter type and the other party's name
Offers open slots from the lawyer's calendar and sends the intake form
Collects the names and flags it; no booking until a lawyer clears it
Answers from the current fee schedule and logs the question
Anything that sounds like legal advice
Says a lawyer will answer and passes it on with the details
Tells them a person will call today and alerts the office manager

images.name: correction
images.title: How one correction *becomes a rule*
rows: Drafts a reply promising a callback "tomorrow"
Manager changes it to "within two business days" and approves it
Manager notes why: the team books callbacks two days out
The sentence goes into the handbook under "Callback requests"
Last month's test cases run again with the new rule
Weekly log review: no repeat of the mistake

images.name: quote
images.text: An AI Employee only knows what's written down. *Training it means writing down what your staff already know.*
